welcome.title: Welcome to Aurora
welcome.description: Aurora is KDE Plasma on a modern, immutable Linux base. Thanks for testing!

features.title: KDE Plasma Desktop
features.description: Aurora ships KDE Plasma 6 on freedesktop-sdk with automatic daily updates via bootc.

community.title: Getting Started
community.description: After installation, Aurora updates automatically. Use Discover for Flatpak apps.

completed.title: Ready to Install
completed.description: Select a disk to install Aurora. The process takes a few minutes.
